concerns.text: FR-001 (Randomized assignment) is tagged on T009, but T011, T012, and T013 (the actual UI implementations for High/Low/Control conditions) lack explicit FR-001 tags. While T009 implements the logic, the tasks describing the condition interfaces themselves do not explicitly claim coverage of the requirement to 'present three distinct experimental conditions', creating a traceability gap for the UI layer.

FR-002 (Capture adherence and trust) is tagged on T014 and T016, but T015 (Attention check) and T018 (Manipulation check) are missing FR-002 tags. FR-002 explicitly requires capturing 'behavioral adherence... and self-reported trust', but the spec also implies capturing attention checks and manipulation checks as part of the data capture for US-1. The lack of tags on T015 and T018 obscures their coverage of the data capture requirement.

FR-006 (Sensitivity analysis) is tagged on T030, but T031 (Final report generation) and T032 (Null result handling) lack FR-006 tags. FR-006 requires the system to 'execute a sensitivity analysis... and report the stability'. T031 is responsible for compiling and reporting these results, yet it is not tagged to FR-006, leaving the 'report' portion of the requirement unlinked to a specific task.

SC-004 (Trust scale verbatim match) is tagged on T016, but T007e (Create docs/trust_scale_items.md) and T007g (Verify trust scale) are missing SC-004 tags. SC-004 requires the system to capture data using the 'exact item set... verifiable by comparing... against the source instrument'. T007e and T007g are the critical tasks that establish and verify this exact item set; without tags, the traceability chain for the 'verbatim' requirement is broken at the source.

SC-005 (Family-wise error correction) is tagged on T023, but T022 (Planned contrasts) and T024 (Effect sizes) are missing SC-005 tags. While T023 implements the Tukey HSD, SC-005 is a success criterion for the *entire* analysis pipeline's error control. The lack of tags on the surrounding analysis tasks (T022, T024) makes it difficult to verify that the full pipeline context for SC-005 is covered.

T000c references 'research/citation_verification_log.md' as a deliverable, but the spec and plan do not explicitly define this file as a required artifact for the 'Verified Accuracy' gate. While T000c creates it, the lack of a corresponding requirement in the spec/plan for this specific log file creates a potential 'stale tag' or 'orphan artifact' situation where the task creates a file not explicitly mandated by the upstream plan.
